an5.256:1.1: “Without abandoning these five qualities, one is incapable of entering & remaining in the first jhāna.
an5.256:1.3: Stinginess as to one’s monastery (lodgings), stinginess as to one’s family (of supporters), stinginess as to one’s gains, stinginess as to one’s status, and stinginess as to the Dhamma.
an5.256:1.4: Without abandoning these five qualities, one is incapable of entering & remaining in the first jhāna.
an5.256:2.1: “With the abandoning of these five qualities, one is capable of entering & remaining in the first jhāna.
an5.256:2.3: Stinginess as to one’s monastery (lodgings)… one’s family (of supporters)… one’s gains… one’s status, and stinginess as to the Dhamma.
an5.256:2.4: With the abandoning of these five qualities, one is capable of entering & remaining in the first jhāna.”
